rationale: The parties have converged on the need for quantified plant-level data and acknowledge the same trade-offs, but the core conflict remains unresolved: employee-side actors still reject closures and compulsory redundancies while management, owners, and investors still insist on structural cost reduction and keep closures viable. The exchange has hardened into a stable impasse with repeated demands for the same audit, so further rounds without an intervention are unlikely to change the substantive positions.
